name: Apollo 8
about: Apollo 8 (1968-118A), a crewed vehicle (Apollo II), launched 1968 Dec 21. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DSO).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1968 Dec 21), held fixed
